author: Jessica Wong
description: A new report says Canadian students are still feeling the impact of the COVID pandemic's massive upset to their schooling, with declining achievement — particularly in math — and a discrepancy between standardized test scores and the grades kids receive in class.
title: COVID-19 school disruptions still impacting students today, learning loss report finds

author: Nicole Brockbank
description: Self-described "Crypto King" Aiden Pleterski described being beaten with a gun and tortured with knives and a lighter in the back of a truck as he began his testimony at the trial of his alleged kidnappers Friday in Toronto.
title: 'Crypto King' Aiden Pleterski testifies he was beaten, tortured during alleged kidnapping

author: Bobbi-Jean MacKinnon
description: New Brunswick RCMP have released the photo of a Moncton man facing several charges in connection with a child luring investigation, as well as a list of communities he has "spent time in" across Canada to encourage people with information to come forward.
title: Moncton man charged in child luring case has 'spent time in' 5 provinces, RCMP say

author: Lisa Johnson
description: Alberta's government is asking a judge to strike down a First Nation's constitutional challenge of its sovereignty act, arguing the law hasn't had any impact on treaty rights.
title: Alberta government asks judge to dismiss First Nation’s challenge of its sovereignty act

description: Santander said in an Instagram post Friday that reflection and conversations with people he trusts made him recognize he should have been more thoughtful about what he shared.
title: 'I sincerely apologize': Blue Jays outfielder Santander apologizes days after anti-Muslim social media posts
Flights grounded across U.S. due to outage affecting air traffic control, FAA says

description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Friday he was frustrated with the Commerce Department's delay in placing restrictions on Nvidia chip exports to a company led by an alleged Chinese spy.
title: U.S. Treasury Secretary frustrated by Commerce Department's inaction on Nvidia chips

description: A tanker struck a cruise boat with 129 passengers on board in New Orleans on Friday, partially submerging the boat.
title: Rescue underway in New Orleans after tanker hits river cruise boat

author: Vincent McDermott
description: The province says the OGP is designed to lower upfront financial barriers to new projects and expansions, particularly as proponents of the Pacific Link pipeline look for companies to fill upcoming capacity.
title: Alberta announces royalty program as part of plan to double oilsands production
Stelco recalling 175 laid-off workers at Hamilton steel plant

author: Alex Flood, Kate Rutherford
description: A butterfly from Manitoulin Island, Ont., flew a 3,300 kilometres to an overwintering site in Mexico, a journey which included crossing Lake Huron and Lake Michigan.
title: Manitoulin Island monarch butterfly completes 1st confirmed flight over Great Lakes

author: Alexandra Mae Jones
description: Six more women have come forward alleging sexual misconduct and predatory behaviour by ex-comedian Russell Brand, according to an investigation by the U.K.-based The Times, following his conviction on rape and sexual assault earlier this week.
title: Russell Brand accused by 6 women of sexual misconduct, assault following rape conviction

author: Meghan Grant
description: Alberta’s top court has overturned the certification of a class-action lawsuit filed by a group of business owners who were seeking compensation for losses suffered due to pandemic-related public health restrictions and closures.
title: Alberta's top court overturns certification for class-action lawsuit over COVID restrictions

author: Griffin Jaeger
description: Canadian pop-punk princess Avril Lavigne has welcomed her first child — a baby girl — with an unnamed partner.
title: Avril Lavigne welcomes baby girl

description: Canada had to fight hard to advance to the semifinals of the women’s world hockey championship by edging the Czech Republic 3-2 on Friday in Herning, Denmark.
title: Canadian women pass stern test from Czechs at hockey worlds, advancing to semifinals

description: Mexico has raised roughly $5.4 million by auctioning off a rare collection of motorcycles seized from alleged Canadian drug lord Ryan Wedding, with the funds earmarked for social services.
title: Mexico raises $5.4M for social services by selling off Ryan Wedding's motorbike collection

author: Christine Pagulayan
description: Former child actor Christian Cousins, who shared the role of Dominic Palmieri in Kindergarten Cop with his twin brother, Joey, has died at 43. His half-brother, Jonas Roeser, announced the news on Instagram, writing Cousins had been seriously ill with liver disease.
title: Kindergarten Cop child actor Christian Cousins dead at 43

author: Abby Cole
description: The Transportation Safety Board of Canada says it's still gathering information regarding a plane that lost two different wheels in separate incidents in the past two weeks.
title: Transportation Safety Board not investigating after PAL Airlines lost wheel twice in 2 weeks

description: SpaceX's latest Starship flight planned for Friday will include its first attempt to catch the spacecraft at its Texas launch site, rather than discarding it in ‌the ocean — a key test of Elon Musk's bid to make a fully reusable rocket system.
title: SpaceX to attempt to catch its first Starship on land in 15th flight

description: CFL commissioner Stewart Johnston says Quebec City has emerged as a leading candidate for an expansion franchise. Johnston made the comments Friday at his second state of the league address, saying the CFL has had substantive conversations with a prospective owner in the Quebec capital.
title: CFL commissioner says Quebec City has emerged as leading contender for expansion

author: Thomas Daigle
description: A three-decade search for a predator dubbed southern Ontario's "woodland rapist" has ended with a Toronto man convicted of kidnapping and sexual assault.
title: Richard Neil found guilty in 1990s 'woodland rapist' cold case

description: Canada finished with five medals in four sports as the Summer Youth Olympics concluded Friday in Dakar, Senegal.
title: Canada finishes 14-day Youth Olympics with 5 medals in Senegal

author: Janet French
description: Presidents of 15 United Conservative Party constituency associations say they won’t sign a revised code of conduct requiring them to publicly respect and abide by the result of a provincial referendum on national unity.
title: 15 United Conservative constituency presidents won't sign agreement to publicly back Alberta referendum result

author: Jackson Weaver
description: Ebenezer, the latest remake of Charles Dickens's A Christmas Carol, isn't terrible. It's also not particularly interesting.
title: Ebenezer review: Merry Christmas, Johnny Depp! Is this your comeback yet?

description: The United Nations nuclear watchdog is "increasingly concerned" about a uranium-enrichment plant at Isfahan that Iran declared to it last year but has still not let the watchdog inspect, it said in a confidential report on Friday seen by Reuters and The Associated Press.
title: UN nuclear watchdog increasingly concerned about Iranian enrichment plant, report says

description: As rain persists on Vancouver Island, fog advisories have been issued for the Cariboo, East Kootenay, Prince George, Similkameen and South Okanagan regions on Friday.
title: More stormy weather forecast for B.C. with warnings for flooding, heavy rain, fog
Global Microsoft outage stretches into 2nd day

author: Wallis Snowdon
description: The parents of an autistic teenager who was arrested at an Alberta playground and detained by RCMP four years ago are calling for the results of a watchdog investigation to be released.
title: Parents of autistic teen detained by Alberta RCMP demand release of delayed watchdog report

author: Jason Proctor
description: Documents obtained by CBC News reveal the existence of a previously unreported Bishnoi cell known as the Baweja group. Members have been tied to multiple shootings and extortion threats in Alberta and B.C.
title: Guns, swords and pepper spray: Bishnoi-linked extortionists attacked in apparent retaliation

description: Microsoft said in an update Friday that an hours-long outage was affecting a wide range of Microsoft 365 offerings that interact with its Exchange Online and email services. Services including Outlook, Teams and AI assistant Copilot were reported by users to be down.
title: Microsoft outages extend into 2nd day worldwide, company not aware of malicious activity

author: Lauren Scott
description: A Winnipeg nurse says she's spent more than three weeks at Health Sciences Centre after a surgery to treat her chronic illness left her with gaping wounds, necrotic tissue and an infection. Emma Cloney had a skin-excision surgery to help treat lipedema on Oct. 20.
title: Winnipeg woman spends weeks in hospital after surgery to treat chronic illness goes wrong

author: Inayat Singh
description: Developing countries want to make finance for climate adaptation and disaster relief a top priority at the COP31 summit in Turkey in light of the recent devastating floods in Nepal — a tragedy that has laid bare the inadequacy of current programs, experts say.
title: Countries vulnerable to climate disaster push for faster, easier access to finance at COP31

author: Kristy Nease
description: A 45-year-old former Uber Eats delivery driver has pleaded guilty to harassing a 12-year-old girl with "secret admirer" messages and candy, as well as prowling her home at night, after he met her while dropping off an order she had placed.
title: Ex Ottawa Uber driver admits to giving 12-year-old girl 'secret admirer' candy, prowling house after delivery

author: Krista Hessey, Linda Guerriero, Ioanna Roumeliotis
description: Two men moved into an elderly Toronto woman's home and began claiming to be like her sons. She quickly gave them powers of attorney and signed a will, leaving them everything. Then she died.
title: They called her 'Mommy': Vulnerable senior dies after 2 strangers take over her life

author: Bobby Hristova, Kathleen Coughlin, Rosa Marchitelli
description: Marketplace tested six of the most popular Android and iOS apps in Canada — Tim Hortons, PC Optimum, Weather Network, Facebook, Amazon and YouTube — to find out what data they collect and where it goes.
title: We tested 6 popular apps to see what data they collect and share. Here’s what we found

author: Eric Michael Johnson
description: One in four people has been prescribed a drug for which their genetics could affect treatment, according to a recent study. Genetic testing could help doctors choose safer, more effective drugs, but cost and other barriers currently limit its routine use in Canada, researchers say.
title: Your genes could change your prescription. So why aren't doctors testing?
